notes.title: Update Reverted
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, the last update we made has been reverted due to several issues with the game. We will be fixing these issues and re-updating it. Sorry about this.

Thank you,
Gladiator Games Team

notes.title: Bug Fixes | Midnight at Forest 2 News
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Sorry for the lack of updates lately, this may be the last update before Midnight at Forest 2!
Let's get right into the patch notes before we give any hints about Midnight at Forest 2.

[list]
[*] Changed the Sprint Cooldown in Easy mode from 0s to 1s
[*] Fixed a glitch where you could still click buttons on the main menu while being in the loading screen
[*] Re-designed the loading screen
[/list]

I've also figured out that there's a speed glitch, but I've decided to keep it in the game because it's kind of funny.

[b][h1]Midnight at Forest 2[/h1][/b]
We've already planned a bit of Midnight at Forest 2, and we're gonna start working on it. This will include more than 95% of the assets being created by us (we may use unity assets). We don't want to give too many spoilers but it's gonna be amazing. I'll give you guys two words.

[h2]VR
Multiplayer[/h2]

Thank you!
Rayne,
Head Developer

notes.title: Feature & Bug Fix Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 3 modes (Easy, Medium, Hard)
[/list]

[h3]The mode settings are as followed:[/h3]

[h2]Easy: [/h2]
Sprint Speed: 10
Sprint Duration: 15s
Sprint Cooldown: 0s
Monster Speed: 1
Key-O-Meter: Enabled

[h2]Medium: [/h2]
Sprint Speed: 7
Sprint Duration: 13s
Sprint Cooldown: 3s
Monster Speed: 2.5
Key-O-Meter: Enabled

[h2]Hard:[/h2]
Sprint Speed: 5
Sprint Duration: 10s
Sprint Cooldown: 5s
Monster Speed: 3.5
Key-O-Meter: Disabled

[list]
[*] Added a How To Play button, which tells you how to play
[*] Added some small features to the map (Hut, Rocks)
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
The Key-O-Meter now disappears once at 5 keys (so you don't get fooled)
Other small bugs


If there are any bugs, make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/nrFSp8VugF]discord[/url]

Also please expect bug fixes throughout the week

Thank you,
Gladiator Games Team

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, this should be one of the last bug fixes until our next major update. The bugs were discovered a while ago but I couldn't fix it, I apologize for that.

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the fog not loading in
[*] Changed some text size for smaller screens
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Here are some bug fixes for you guys, not too much.

[list]
[*] Fixed text clipping in to the sprint bar
[*] Actually made the monster slower
[*] Fixed the key score not resetting when restarting the game
[/list]

notes.title: Features & Bug Fixes (Including a key-o-meter)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this update was supposed to come out with our improved map textures. But we realized it was near impossible to find keys. So here you go

[list]
[*]Added red fog once 5 keys have been obtained
[*]Added something that tells you how far away the keys are
[*]Changed Main Menu music
[*]Changed monster music to ambience
[*]The monster is now slower
[*]Changed the sprint cooldown from 5 seconds to 3 seconds
[*]When muting the radio, the text now disappears
[/list]

Map textures should be coming out soon.

Make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/nrFSp8VugF]discord [/url]if there are any bugs or for announcements, or comment it on this post.

Thank you,
Gladiator Games Team

notes.title: Major Update in progress
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Rayne here.
We're getting lots of feedback about the current state of our game. So we're going to be giving you guys an explanation of what we are doing now.

We would like to say that currently, an update is in progress. This update will include, but not limited to:

[list]
[*] Better map textures
[*] New sound effects
[*] A way to find keys easily
[/list]

We would also like to thank everyone for the positive feedback even though Midnight at Forest isn't in a good state. We will continue to update the game as much as we can and take as much feedback as we can.

Be sure to see sneak peeks in our [h1][url=https://discord.gg/nrFSp8VugF]Discord[/url][/h1]

Thank you,
Rayne.

notes.title: Bug Fixes & New features
notes.notes:
This update will include both features and bug fixes. The changes are as followed

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added the ability to skip the radio by pressing 'M'
[*] Added music to the monster, it now gets louder the closer you get
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] You now cannot glitch out of the map
[*] Fixed credits
[/list]

notes.title: v0.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:

The changes are as followed:

[/list]
